title: Declare the it_companies list
description:
Declare a list variable named it_companies and assign initial values Facebook, Google, Microsoft, Apple, IBM, Oracle and Amazon.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as it_companies(), returning the list ['Facebook', 'Google', 'Microsoft', 'Apple', 'IBM', 'Oracle', 'Amazon'] in that exact order.
hints: The order of the company names matters - keep them exactly in the order given.
This is a plain list literal with 7 string items.
expected_behavior: Returns the 7-item list of IT company names in the given order.
explanation: The exercise specifies both the values and their order, so the solution is simply that exact list literal.
